title: Internal: Backend Incident 11/13
summary: This document defines an incident-specific transfer protocol for backend reports until 11/15/2025 at 11:59 PM EST when a customer says they paid their credit card statement, the amount was deducted from checking, and the payment is not reflected in the credit card statement balance. Identity verification is not required; agents must follow a three-step transfer tool order (initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822, then initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218, then transfer_to_human_agents on the third request) without collecting extra details during the incident window.
